{
  "B_expression": "-1/(2*(1+u)*(sqrt((1+u)**2 + r) + (1+u))**2)",
  "C_expression": "-1/(2*(1+u))",
  "derivation": "Let A=1+u and S=sqrt(A*A+r). On the inner support where chi_r=chi_u=1, the positive root of (1+u+g)^2=(1+u)^2+r is g_star=S-A=r/(S+A). The supplied structure requires g=r/2+r*r*B(r,u)+u*r*C(r,u). Choosing C=-1/(2*A) and B=-1/(2*A*(S+A)^2) gives r*r*B+u*r*C = r/(S+A)-r/2 by rationalizing S-A, so g equals g_star and the whole signed residual E=(2*g+g*g-r)+2*u*g vanishes on that inner region. The formula is C-infinity wherever A>0 and A*A+r>0; the closed host rectangle has A in [3/4,5/4] and A*A+r>=1/16, so an open smooth neighborhood exists. At u=0 the B arm reduces to the source-only body and the C arm is multiplied by u, so the previous u=0 cancellation is retained. Outside the chi support the fixed host falls back to the linear r/2 step; no root extension is claimed there.",
  "inspect": [],
  "note": "Retain this exact-core pair only for the stated coefficient family. A successor should check that future targets keep evaluated points inside the host rectangle and keep A*A+r positive; rows with |r|>1/2 or |u|>1/4 are outside body evaluation and remain linear or unapplied by design. Nonzero residuals on chi transition rows are expected and do not invalidate the inner cancellation. Machine-zero or small residuals on the finite grid are not a uniform analytic-domain certificate, not a proof of smoothness over all of R^2, and not a full PDE or Navier-Stokes result. If the rectangle is widened, re-verify A>0 and A*A+r>0 before reusing these expressions."
